title: Client Project Folder Generator v2.0.1 Official Release
changelog: • Custom Template Isolation: Option to disable standard 5 subfolders when using custom templates.
• In-App 1-Click Auto-Updater: Instant check (F5) and seamless self-update.

• 6 Dynamic Themes with Windows System Dark/Light auto-detection.
